target: workflow.sh merge — an owner=plugin region's body is replaced by the template's; an owner=project region and unmarked text are left alone
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/workflow-fixture.sh"; wf_file project.js '// unmarked line 1' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("old greeting");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=notes owner=project' 'my custom notes here' '// @agentic-loop:end region=notes' '// unmarked line 2'; wf_file template.js '// unmarked line 1' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("new greeting");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=notes owner=project' 'ignored project template notes' '// @agentic-loop:end region=notes' '// unmarked line 2'; VERDICT=$(workflow_merge project.js template.js '//' '{}'); BODY=$(cat project.js); jq -n --argjson v "$VERDICT" --arg body "$BODY" '{verdict:$v, body:$body}'
_note: Guards the core split: a plugin-owned region refreshes from the template while a project-owned region (even one the template also defines, with different content) and text outside any marker survive untouched.
